summary: Resupply workbook for VD-22-076, the Elvarmere chiral intermediate campaign B for Elvarmere Biosciences AB. It links the enantiomeric-purity measurements to the isolated mass for each lot, and records the approved release of the delivery lot that restarted the client's downstream synthesis.
